models.label: Metal nut · exploratory pilot
models.description: Compact reconstruction and segmentation model trained from random weights.
models.conditions: Centered metal nuts photographed against a uniform background, matching MVTec AD.
models.evaluation_note: Original metal_nut test: 93 defective / 22 normal images. This test has been inspected during development; these are exploratory results. This legacy pilot used a 95th-percentile threshold; protocol v2 uses the 90th percentile.
